# Party Challenge Catalog Delta

The Awtsmoos reveals every true doorway without forcing one doorway to pretend it is another;
Awtsmoos.com can expose Party Challenge as a complete product while keeping Solo games, party actions, and capability truth distinct from one another.

## Evidence

- All 33 top-level app routes are already represented by `/apps` source registries.
- All top-level game routes are represented except `/games/party/`.
- Party Challenge is a standalone product with setup, 2–4 player selection, rounds, score mode, arena iframe, scoreboard, and its own compact module entry.
- `/games` already promotes Party in hero/quick-launch, but the searchable catalog omits it.
- `/apps` adapts `GAMES`, so adding Party to canonical `GAMES` exposes it automatically in both public catalogs.
- Existing game enrichment assumes every entry is a Solo-playable world and always creates a Party secondary link. Party Challenge itself must not inherit those assumptions.

## Exact change

1. Create `games/scripts/catalog/party.mjs` with one explicit `partyHub: true` record.
2. Rewrite `quick-play.mjs` to include Party ahead of quick-play classics.
3. Rewrite `capabilities/index.mjs` so `partyHub` receives truthful hub metadata, `partyHref: ""`, and primary label `Start Party`, while every existing game preserves current enrichment.
4. Rewrite `markup.mjs` so primary action text comes from metadata and the Party secondary action renders only when `partyHref` exists.
5. Preserve existing game card shape, collection layout, native capability markup, and commerce markup.

## Acceptance

- Canonical top-level app missing list stays empty.
- Canonical top-level game missing list becomes empty.
- Party appears exactly once in `GAMES` and once in adapted `/apps` game records.
- Party card links to `./party/`, primary label says `Start Party`, and contains no self-referential Party secondary CTA.
- Existing non-Party game cards still say `Play Solo` and still include their Party secondary CTA.
- All touched files remain <=120 lines with tab indentation and clean diff checks.
